title: ML inference cost shadowing + headcount scenarios (May 2026)
body:
One-page working sheet: running a set of cost-shadow scenarios that tie: 1) token demand growth, 2) model mix and quantization, 3) GPU-hours and infra ops headcount, and 4) retail pricing per 1k tokens to contribution margin. Purpose: surface break-even price bands and hiring triggers for Q3–Q4 2026.

ASSUMPTIONS (quick):
- Baseline avg tokens/request: 1,200 (chat + system tokens).
- Baseline token growth: +35% QoQ (product-led acceleration window).
- Model mix (baseline): 60% distil/quantized small open model, 30% 7B optimized, 10% 13B full (for high-capability routes).
- Avg latency SLO target: 250–350ms p50 for hosted API routes. Higher-cost routes allowed higher SLOs.
- GPU pricing (on-commit blended): $2.50/hour effective (mix of spot/commit, includes infra overhead).
- Ops/infra labor fully loaded cost per FTE: $220k/year (benefits & infra tooling).
- Time horizon = next 6 months (Jun–Nov 2026).

TABLE (summary rows; formulas shown as plain text):
Columns: Scenario | Token growth | Avg tokens/req | Model mix notes | GPU-hrs/mo | Ops FTEs (infra+sre) | Unit infra cost per 1k tokens | Current price per 1k | Contribution per 1k | Notes
1) Baseline | +35% QoQ | 1,200 | 60/30/10 | 18,000 | 6 | = (GPU $ * GPU-hrs + storage+network)/monthly_tokens *1000 => $7.2 | $9.00 | $1.8 | we assume some caching/prefix reuse (~10% token reduction)
2) Conservative | +15% QoQ | 1,050 | 70/25/5 (more quantized) | 12,500 | 5 | = $5.6 | $8.00 | $2.4 | lower usage; fewer FTEs needed
3) Aggressive | +60% QoQ | 1,400 | 40/40/20 (heavier 13B use) | 28,500 | 9 | = $11.4 | $9.00 | -$2.4 | likely loss-making without price action or more quantization
4) High-quantize experiment | +45% QoQ | 1,200 | 80/15/5 (quant+8-bit) | 9,500 | 5 | = $3.8 | $7.00 | $3.2 | good margin but risk on quality/regressions

HEADCOUNT PLAN (ops + product impact):
- Current baseline ops FTEs allocated to inference: 6 (infra 3, serving runtime 2, SRE 1).
- Hiring triggers (draft):
  * Add 1 infra engineer when monthly GPU-hrs > 22k (sustained 6 weeks).
  * Add 1 SRE when p95 latency regressions exceed 2x SLA for >48 hours despite config pushes.
  * Add 1 applied-ML engineer when quality regression from quantization experiments fall outside acceptance for top 5 customers (ticketed).
- Contingency contracting: budget for up to 2 contractors (avg blended cost $120k FY) for burst support.

PRICING SENSITIVITY (quick elasticity):
- Elasticity assumption: demand short-run elasticity = -0.12 per 10% price increase for core hosted API customers (sticky), but -0.4 for price-sensitive mid-market customers.
- Break-even price per 1k tokens calculated as: unit infra cost per 1k + allocated labor per 1k + 10% margin buffer.
- Example: Baseline unit infra $7.2 + labor alloc ($0.9) + buffer => break-even ~$9.5. With current price $9.0 baseline slightly negative.

SCENARIO ANALYSIS (sizing & runway impact):
- If aggressive demand materializes and we keep price constant, monthly gross loss on inference routes could exceed $120k/month (drives runway impact if sustained).
- If we increase price 10% across the board under aggressive scenario, expected demand drop (elasticity -0.12) reduces tokens ~12%, lowering GPU-hours to ~25k but still above baseline — net margin improves but may still require +2 FTEs for operational complexity.
- High-quantize experiment lowers infra unit cost materially (down toward $3.8/1k) — this creates a 30–40% margin uplift but introduces quality/regression risk; pre-rollout gating required (eval sets + canary traffic <5%).

OPEN QUESTIONS / ACTIONS (TODOs):
- Get updated blended GPU-hour cost from infra-finance (ask: include amortized reserved pool + spot failure uplift). (owner: Priya)
- Run per-customer price-sensitivity quick cohort (top 20 customers) — finance to assign. (owner: Evan)
- Draft canary plan for high-quantize model in prod: evaluation suite + rollback threshold + metric dashboard. (owner: Maya)
- Add modeled labor ramp timing to the scenario sheet (assume 8–10 week hiring lead).

NOTES TO REVIEWERS: this is a working shadow sheet — not final. Use the linked artifacts for the detailed cost model (github PR) and the Confluence page for the full headcount budget. Please comment with:
- additional risk factors we should bake into the aggressive case (e.g., 3rd-party SLA credits),
- alternate pricing bands to simulate (-10%, 0%, +10%, +25%),
- recommended FTE ramp windows (immediate vs phased).

QUICK FORECAST OUTPUT (headline for exec one-liner):
- With current configuration and no price change, expected margin band for hosted inference in next 6 months: -5% to +18% across scenarios. Key levers: quantization and price (primary), ops hiring (secondary).

END OF SHEET — rough table and assumptions above. Keep this doc as the working source for the finance + infra sync on 2026-06-07.
